title: Spaced closure signatures inside a multiline array shape

ground_truth.statement: A shape with required callable a and optional callable b permits invoking a. Its declared result is an array of integer values or null; both runtime controls exercise those branches.

provenance.note: Re-derived two nested signatures from the full mega-annotation. Upstream assigns [] under a lying @var annotation; this fixture takes a real parameter satisfying the shape instead.

notes: Whitespace variant shares its criterion with the unspaced candidate. This is a parse and invocation comparison, not a promise of compatibility with every optional key in the original large shape.
